title: ForgeSettings
description: What a project declares for forge, under settings.forge in agentbay.config.yaml. Only the owner writes it.

featureMap.description: The project's map of features, a YAML file whose features each list entry and private files, such as framework/features.yaml. forge.waves warns of a scope that holds every private file of one feature. Left out, no scope is compared with a feature.

into.description: The branch a slice is merged into when the owner chooses merge, such as integration. It must not be checked out anywhere, since the worktrees mode merges only in a worktree of its own.

practices.description: The practices files a builder reads before it writes, relative to the project, such as framework/practices.md and components/base/typescript/practices.md.

sideBySide.description: How many builders the workflow wave runs at the same time, from 2 to 8. A wave with more slices than this builds them in batches of this many, each batch after the one before; the solo proofs run the same way. Left out, 2.

mustPractices.description: The ids of the practices the workflow rounds treats as must, such as P-12. While the reviewer's last answer says one of them is not held, the merge card withholds merge, naming it; keep stays. Left out, none: a practice not held is then shown on the card and withholds nothing.
